path_convention: Code and artifact paths are relative to the repository root.

project.name: Doodlume
project.summary: Turn your drawings and photographs into playable worlds. Then invent what happens next.
project.problem: People can imagine a game before they can program one. Creating interactive behavior from their own artwork requires tools and skills separate from drawing.
project.solution: Image-and-intent interpretation, original-art extraction, validated gameplay and continued visual authoring in the same world.
intended_users: People who want to turn drawings into playable experiences
Creators who want to make interactive challenges from photographs
People who want to author objects, abilities and game goals without writing game code
project.impact_evidence: Working source-to-play, ability-authoring and save/reopen demonstrations; user adoption and retention have not been measured.
project.final_demo_video_status: Replacement film pending final assembly, owner-voice narration, full playback review and publication.
project.positioning: An indie creation studio for turning personal pictures into playable, editable worlds.
project.value_proposition: Start with your own visual idea, test it by playing, then author new actions and goals in the same persistent world.
